scope: Independent interpretation of accepted labels and subsequent shared-planning/history diagnostics. No production policy changes.
user_direction: 把这次分析和后续判断标准独立于主线，先完成共享规划与自身历史失配诊断，不急着训练调度器。

gates.require: Original accepted capture hash, all four CAL/seed0 and all406 cells per scene; teacher adjacent anchors explicit. No warm, SELECT, DEV, TEST or partial running output.
gates.report: Action-specific log decomposition and exploratory leave-one-CAL-out fixed-cell action regret; never a quality or adaptive upper-bound claim.

gates.require: Complete original PG-P1 independent acceptance including frozen policy identities, full denominators, complete-video scores, clean timing, finance and released original resources.
gates.report: Reuse registered selection unchanged; report feasible candidate losses, measured full-request times, tails, proxy-endpoint ranking and calibration cost. No feasible policy or missing originals stays unresolved, not an adaptive-scheduler justification.

gates.require: Freeze final CARA and registered feasible SIMPLE from P1; original first two CAL_FIT, seed0; preserve existing P2 scope, complete quote, production CPU and fresh exclusive admission. Do not launch a duplicate or split the registered P2 card.
gates.matrix: For each unique policy, one warm and two formal requests; at most six paths. Earliest skipped target in each true-D gap bin 2-4,5-8,>=9; empty bins remain empty; duplicate policy roles share physical paths.
gates.integrity: Shadow OFF/ON controls; exact parent input, solver, cache, anchors, conditions and RNG noninterference; paired original C/A_HALF/A_ONE/D tensors, hashes and source identities; A_ONE invariant to older anchor. Shadow is never a deployed anchor or a clean timing sample.

gates.report: Separate same-state actual-vs-adjacent-window comparison from teacher-table-vs-own-state total mismatch. Preserve action ties, NA constant ranks, absolute regret, zero-denominator NA, per-point/per-prompt losses and policy/bin coverage. Two prompts support mechanism diagnosis, not population confidence or independent406-cell significance.
gates.empty_case: No legal points => NOT_APPLICABLE_FOR_FROZEN_POLICIES; never change policy to create a favorable point.
gates.decision: Rank reversals with nonzero regret flag a history-conditioned surrogate issue; first assess history representation. Stable local ordering with poor endpoint ordering nominates sensitivity/interaction diagnosis. Neither automatically authorizes training.

gates.continue_shared: Shared planning remains the default until a controlled deployable alternative demonstrates useful incremental endpoint benefit at matched measured time on fresh inputs.
gates.optional_future_pilot: Only propose a separately versioned sensitivity or causal online-calibration pilot if S1-S3 identify a concrete unresolved mechanism; report full data/readout/transfer/storage/shadow/score costs first.
gates.learning: Dormant. Any reopening must respect the explicit probe-line closure and obtain a new concrete task decision. No automatic model fitting, new data collection or DAgger iteration from this sidecar.

rejected_shortcuts: 80 percent explained variance is not a stop/go rule for adaptivity.
A 3 percent endpoint gap is not an established margin; a future margin and paired uncertainty procedure must be frozen before fresh evaluation.
Per-prompt teacher-table DP is a privileged comparator, not a true closed-loop oracle.
Uniform positive loss rescaling cannot change a hard-budget optimizer's minimizer.
O(T^2) labels from one deep trajectory do not cost one Native request.
LPIPS is not the sum of scalar local MSE; injected response depends on direction, source, action and solver/history.
